invariant_bindings.invariant_text: `__call__` MUST return the SAME event_dict object it received (in-place mutation) so downstream structlog processors see the redacted payload.
Non-string values (ints, lists, objects) MUST pass through UNCHANGED — the redactor only rewrites string values.
No matter what malformed input arrives, `__call__` MUST NOT raise; a logging processor that throws breaks the entire logging pipeline.
